must: Treat the API decision, actor, tenant, credential-binding ID, kill version, receipt and finality as server-owned; never construct or redefine them in Luzione UI.
Bind every future UI effect reservation to one stable operation key and canonical payload hash, then return the API-issued decision/receipt/readback references unchanged.
Complete CRM-CORRECTION-01 over the separate UI effect-sink inventory before requesting EFFECT-KILL-RECHECK-01.
mustNot: Send credential material or a client-selected credential binding.
Treat a provider acknowledgement, HTTP success or an admitted decision as business finality.
Use this producer packet as proof that any UI sink is guarded or that G1/G2 is met.

must: Pin the exact API implementation SHA and exact contract strings before exercising the Sultan prepare/execute routes.
Preserve the stable operationId/commandHash and consume only the API-owned decision through existing routes.
Keep Sultan logical agents distinct from the authenticated service actor and preserve separate human approval for execution.
mustNot: Implement a Sultan-local effect admission, kill version, credential resolver, receipt or finality authority.
Pass tenant, actor, raw token, credential binding or kill state as model-controlled authority.
Activate provider effects from this bounded candidate.
